title: Subgroup Catalog
description: Schema for per-indication subgroup catalogs. Lives at data-catalog/subgroup-catalogs/{indication}/{version}.yaml. Defines atomic strata (single-axis subgroups) and composite cohorts (intersections of atomic strata) along with the derivation rule that maps source data to per-sample assignments. The subgroup_assigner_* methods consume this catalog and emit assignment Parquets validating against subgroup_assignment.schema.json. See plan § Subgroup Framework (Section near line 1024) + the iter-1b subtyping additions.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for this catalog version (e.g., 'coadread-subgroups-2026-q2').

manifest_kind.description: Discriminator for data-catalog manifest indexing; always 'subgroup_catalog' for this schema.

indication.description: OncoTree code or canonical indication abbreviation (COADREAD, PDAC, NSCLC, SCLC, GC).

version.description: Catalog version identifier (typically a release-pin tag like '2026-Q2').

default_source.description: Default data-source binding for atomic strata that don't override. Backward-compat: iter-1a YAMLs use `source:` at top level — the schema accepts either form. Iter-1b convention: use `default_source` to make the override semantics explicit.

source.description: Iter-1a convention: top-level `source` block. Equivalent to `default_source`. Kept for backward compatibility.

atomic_strata.description: Single-axis strata. Each stratum has an id, label, rule, and (when not using default_source) its own data-source binding.

composite_cohorts.description: Intersections of atomic strata (e.g., 'MSS_RASMut_3Lplus' = MSS AND KRAS_mut AND treatment_line_3plus). Iter-1b ships with no composite cohorts; iter-2 may add.

iter2_expansion_pending.description: Free-form list of strata explicitly deferred to iter-2 (e.g., classifier-derived subtypes). Documentation only; no schema enforcement beyond it being a list of strings.

review_decision.description: Sign-off state. Only `approved` catalogs are usable in latest_approved data mode.

atomic_stratum.$comment: The `dependentRequired` block below is the COMPENSATING STRENGTHENING for declaring the five keys that made this corpus invalid. Declaring a key to take an error count to zero is, on its own, relaxing a gate to match the build -- it adds no checking power. This block adds the power back, and it is BIDIRECTIONAL on purpose: forward (n -> note) stops an unprovenanced count, and reverse (note -> n) stops a note for a cohort the stratum does not declare, which would be provenance with nothing behind it. Verified landable, not aspirational: all 7 cohort families pair exactly 1:1 on main as of 2026-09-13 (depmap 84/84, tcga 32/32, tcga_coadread 24/24, tcga_nsclc 18/18, tcga_pdac 12/12, tcga_sclc 5/5, tcga_gc 5/5 = 180/180), so this lands green and only constrains future edits. ★ EXTENDED 2026-09-14 to close a HALF-DECLARED NAME FAMILY in SIX places. A NAME FAMILY IS TWO HALVES -- the token that DECLARES a cohort in `applicable_data_sources`, and the `expected_n_<token>` key that CARRIES that cohort's count. Declaring only the first half yields a schema that lets a stratum name a cohort and then FORBIDS it from recording that cohort's denominator, and because the corpus cannot contain a key the schema rejects, the missing half reads as forgotten rather than forbidden and nothing goes red. Three of the six (`genie`, `genie_bpc`, `george_2015`) were introduced by the 2026-09-13 closure itself -- it added them to the enum, which is what took the corpus from 110 errors to 0, without their count keys. The other three (`ccle`, `gdsc`, `tempus`) have been asymmetric since the schema was WRITTEN (f9a7c22), which is the real finding: the defect is structural, not a slip, and it recurred in 2026-09-13 precisely because nothing asserted the two halves cover the same token set. `tests/schemas/test_subgroup_catalog_contract.py::test_every_declarable_source_can_record_its_own_denominator` now DERIVES that assertion from this file, so a seventh token cannot be added to the enum alone. All six new families pair 0/0 today, so the addition lands green and only enables future writes; the data-catalog PR that follows fills 7 of the 11 (stratum, declared-cohort) pairs that were unrecordable, all 7 on `genie`/`genie_bpc`.

id.description: Stable identifier for this stratum (e.g., MSI_H, KRAS_mut, KRAS_G12C). Convention: TitleCase-with-underscores for biological terms; ALL_CAPS_WITH_UNDERSCORES acceptable.

description.description: Biological / clinical definition of the stratum.

rule.description: CEL-compatible predicate that, when evaluated against source data, identifies samples belonging to this stratum. For directly_tagged: `clinical.{field} == '{value}'`. For maf_filter: predicates over MAF records (e.g., `gene_symbol == 'KRAS' && variant in ['p.G12C', 'p.G12D']`). For classifier_run (iter-2): `classifier.label == '{slot_id}'`.

derivation_source.description: How this stratum's assignments are derived. Iter-1b operational: directly_tagged_*, maf_filter_per_rule. Iter-2: classifier_run. Required for any stratum that doesn't inherit derivation from default_source/source.

data_source.description: Per-stratum data-source override. If absent, the catalog's default_source/source block applies.

min_caller_count.description: Caller-agreement threshold for multi-caller consensus products (tcga-fusion-consensus-per-sample-v1: TumorFusions + Gao 2018 + cBioPortal PanCancer Atlas). 1 = union / 'any caller', which is what 'any fusion partner' means. Shipped in NSCLC and PAAD fusion strata since 2026-07-22 but UNDECLARED here until 2026-09-13, so a typo in the key name would have been silently ignored by any reader defaulting it.

expected_n_tcga.description: Measured member count for this stratum on the canonical TCGA cohort. NOT an estimate: as of 2026-09-13 every declaration in every catalog is either a measured count or paired with a note saying explicitly that it is not (data-catalog #598 measured all 180). Read it together with its `_denominator_note` sibling, which `dependentRequired` makes mandatory -- the bare integer is ambiguous between a measurement, a real zero, and an N/A sentinel.

expected_n_genie.description: Measured member count on the GENIE registry cohort. ★ ADDED 2026-09-14 to close a HALF-DECLARED NAME FAMILY. The 2026-09-13 schema closure added `genie`/`genie_bpc` to the `applicable_data_sources` enum -- which is what took the corpus from 110 validation errors to 0 -- but did NOT add the matching `expected_n_*` names. Under `unevaluatedProperties: false` that produced a schema which lets a stratum DECLARE a cohort and then forbids it from ever recording that cohort's denominator. Declared 3 times (COADREAD KRAS_mut / KRAS_G12C / BRAF_V600E) with 0 keys, because the key was UNREPRESENTABLE, not because it was forgotten.

expected_n_genie_bpc.description: Measured member count on the GENIE-BPC (Biopharma Collaborative) cohort, which carries treatment-line detail the registry does not. ★ ADDED 2026-09-14, same half-declared-family defect as `expected_n_genie`. This one hid MEASURED data: the 6 line-of-therapy strata (COADREAD + NSCLC LOT_1L_only / LOT_2L / LOT_3Lplus) declare `genie_bpc` as their ONLY source, and their assignments shards have been published the whole time -- 205/203/768 of 1176 evaluable for COADREAD, 298/243/552 of 1093 for NSCLC, all six clearing the n>=30 floor. They read as unmeasured because the schema gave them nowhere to say otherwise.

expected_n_george_2015.description: Measured member count on the George et al. 2015 SCLC cohort. ★ ADDED 2026-09-14, third instance of the same half-declared family from the 2026-09-13 closure: the token was added to `applicable_data_sources` specifically so the SCLC NAPY claim could be RECORDED, and the key that carries its count was not, so the claim remained half-unrecordable. 0 keys today (the SCLC catalog declares only tcga/depmap on its strata) -- this makes the NAPY measurement writable when it is run.

expected_n_ccle.description: Measured member count on the CCLE cell-line cohort. ★ ADDED 2026-09-14. Unlike the genie/george families this one is NOT from the 2026-09-13 closure -- `ccle`, `gdsc` and `tempus` have been declarable in `applicable_data_sources` since the schema was written (f9a7c22) with no matching count key, so the asymmetry is ORIGINAL to the file rather than introduced. That is why it recurred: nothing anywhere asserted the two halves cover the same tokens, so the second half was invisible by construction. 0 keys today.

expected_n_gdsc.description: Measured member count on the GDSC cell-line cohort. ★ ADDED 2026-09-14; see `expected_n_ccle` for why this family was missing since f9a7c22. 0 keys today.

expected_n_tempus.description: Measured member count on the Tempus real-world cohort. ★ ADDED 2026-09-14; see `expected_n_ccle` for why this family was missing since f9a7c22. 0 keys today.

expected_n_tcga_denominator_note.description: Provenance for the sibling `expected_n_tcga`, in one of four forms: `Observed emit <date> against <manifest> (n~<evaluable> evaluable of <rows> rows; <members> members).` | `NOT MEASURED as of <date> (<disposition>): <reason>` | `Not applicable ...` (the 0 is an N/A sentinel, not a measured zero) | `Corrected ...` (a stray expectation for a source the stratum excludes). ★ The denominator quoted is the EVALUABLE one, never the cohort size: HNSC HPV_negative has 279 rows but HPV is called on only 52, so `45` alone reads as 45-of-279 and misleads by 5x.

expected_n_depmap_denominator_note.description: Provenance for the sibling `expected_n_depmap`; same four forms as `expected_n_tcga_denominator_note`.

applies_within.description: Subset of the indication's cohort within which the stratum's rule should be evaluated. L6 fix (post-adversarial-review): mutation strata for histologically-mixed indications (NSCLC = LUAD + LUSC) declare which histology denominator the expected_n is calibrated against, AND phase-2 subgroup_assigner_maf_filter restricts iteration to that cohort before applying the predicate.

expected_n_depmap.description: Approximate DepMap cell-line count for this stratum (when applicable).

applicable_data_sources.description: Which data sources support this stratum. IN USE as of 2026-09-13: tcga (81), depmap (62), genie_bpc (6), genie (3). ★ genie/genie_bpc shipped in the COADREAD and NSCLC catalogs while absent from this enum, which is why the corpus was schema-invalid (9 of the 110 errors): the enum was the NARROWER of the two vocabularies routing this one axis. The other is `subtype_crosswalk.yaml`'s per-stratum `cohorts:` list. FORWARD-DECLARED with zero catalog uses, for two different reasons: `george_2015` because the crosswalk ALREADY claims it for the four SCLC NAPY strata and no catalog could express that claim while the token was missing here (so those 4 discrepancies were structurally unfixable, not curator error); `tempus`/`ccle`/`gdsc` because iter-2 is expected to need them and a widened enum cannot invalidate anything. Full reconciliation of the two vocabularies is TRACKED, NOT done here -- see `cohort_claim_reconciliation` in subtype_crosswalk.yaml.

components.description: Intersection of atomic strata + optional non-molecular constraints (line of therapy, etc.).

molecular_subgroups.description: Atomic stratum IDs that must ALL be true for a sample to belong to this composite cohort.
